en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a serene bay with two small islets: in the foreground a low whitewashed chapel complex on a tiny island linked by a narrow causeway, and farther back a tree‑covered islet with a prominent building amid cypress trees. Hills rise in the background. Greek text and the word "CORFOU" appear in the lower right, and a web address watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is printed across the lower part of the image.
